hypotheses.falsifier: future leakage, duplicated settlement or missing denominator

hypotheses.claim: Prior focus/freshness model changes actual routing under discriminating cases, preserving fixed-population fairness
hypotheses.falsifier: model control absent or fairness/admission violation

hypotheses.claim: Actual protected interpreter executes the same bound bundle and frozen input

hypotheses.claim: Real paired adapter enforces one-factor scope, one deadline and complete six-cell denominator

hypotheses.claim: Cohort retains original schedule, actual elapsed timestamps and ambiguous-launch reconciliation
